issue_context.title: sql: `crdb_internal.force_delete_table_data` should use `DeleteRange` in 22.2
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Relates to https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/70427. Maybe the system tenant should be able to issue `ClearRange` optionally, but it's not totally clear. The secondary tenants shouldnot.


**Describe the solution you'd like**

Change the `ClearRange` code after the version is active to use `DeleteRange` with tombstones.



Jira issue: CRDB-18423

Epic CRDB-2624
comments: @ajwerner Is this something that SQL schema can pick up?
We should get this in now that we're entering stability.
Opened up https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/86137, will see if there is any fallout.

review_comments: Do we need to worry about unbounded parallelization here? Also, is it worth adding in admission control headers?
We didn't in the `ClearRange` code which preceded this. I think we have all the same fast-paths now, no?
I guess the argument is that the user has decided to take this dire action. I don't know. I honestly have never used this thing. It came out of a post-mortem. I don't care about it really.
Hm ok, probably fine then. Seems like the sort of thing you'd pull in an emergency.
